# v0.10.4 - Two macOS Fixes Found by a CI Probe

## What's Changed in v0.10.4

A fixes-only release (maintenance mode): two bugs reproduced on macOS (APFS) by a CI probe, one on a plain folder with an embedded repository, a gitlink warning that printed a quoted name, and two warn-first deprecations (`--no-embedded-repos`, `--restore --payload-jobs`). Each fix has a test that fails without it.

### Fixed
- **macOS**: a file renamed by the case of a non-ASCII letter (`Über.txt` -> `über.txt`) is no longer kept under both names in every later snapshot. A restore of a snapshot holding a composed and a decomposed spelling of one name (`café` twice) no longer ends in "defect in the checkout".
- **`--default-excludes`** no longer drops what an embedded repository committed under `node_modules` (or another fixed pattern) when the source is a plain folder, not a repository.
- **Embedded-repository warning**: a gitlink whose name holds a double quote, backslash, tab or newline is named as it is spelled.

### Deprecated
- **A snapshot run with `--no-embedded-repos` now prints a `Warning:`**: from 0.11 the option also needs `--allow-gitlinks` (an embedded repository is recorded as its commit id only, and a restore gives an empty directory).
- **`--restore --payload-jobs` now prints a `Warning:`**: a restore never read the job count; it is refused from 0.11. A job with `--exit-warnings` that passes either exits `3` until it is dropped. See "Options by mode" in `SNAPSHOT.md`.
- Announced for 0.11, with the old flags accepted for one release: subcommands for the snapshot tool.

### Upgrading

Nothing about what is stored changes and no setting is renamed. See "Upgrading to v0.10.4" in `UPGRADING.md`.

The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
